title: Prokaryotic Adaptive Immunity via Clustered Genomic Repeats
pre_discovery_prompt: Bacterial genomes contain identical 20-40bp interspaced repeat arrays separated by variable spacer sequences matching bacteriophage DNA. What functional physiological role does this system serve?
ground_truth_finding: An adaptive immune memory system that transcribes spacer sequences into small RNA guides to direct Cas nuclease cleavage of invading viral DNA.
notes_on_reconstruction: Stripped CRISPR/Cas9 acronyms and bacterial strain names.
